grammar.label: Grammar
grammar.description: Sentence structure, verb forms, articles, and agreement.

bands.label: Excellent
bands.criteria: Few or no grammatical errors; sentences are well formed.

bands.label: Good
bands.criteria: Minor errors that do not block understanding.

bands.label: Fair
bands.criteria: Noticeable errors but the message is still clear.

bands.label: Needs work
bands.criteria: Frequent errors that make the writing hard to follow.

vocabulary.label: Vocabulary
vocabulary.description: Range and appropriateness of words for the level and topic.

bands.label: Excellent
bands.criteria: Varied, topic-appropriate words with little repetition.

bands.label: Good
bands.criteria: Adequate word choice with some variety.

bands.label: Fair
bands.criteria: Basic words only; limited range or heavy repetition.

bands.label: Needs work
bands.criteria: Very limited vocabulary; many repeated words.

relevance.label: Relevance
relevance.description: The answer addresses the prompt and stays on topic.

bands.label: Excellent
bands.criteria: Fully answers the prompt with appropriate detail.

bands.label: Good
bands.criteria: Mostly on topic; minor gaps in addressing the prompt.

bands.label: Fair
bands.criteria: Partially on topic or too short to judge fully.

bands.label: Needs work
bands.criteria: Off topic or does not answer the question.

coherence.label: Coherence
coherence.description: Logical flow, sentence linking, and readable organization.

bands.label: Excellent
bands.criteria: Clear flow; ideas connect smoothly with linking words.

bands.label: Good
bands.criteria: Generally organized; minor jumps between ideas.

bands.label: Fair
bands.criteria: Ideas are present but order or linking is weak.

bands.label: Needs work
bands.criteria: Hard to follow; fragmented or one long unstructured block.
